title: Jefferson County History Center

services.name: JCHS Historical Cemetery Tour
services.desc: The resurrected cemetery tour from years past, held on Saturday October 26th, was a guided tour led by Board President Larry Anthony of some of our historical characters of the community and county. Here's your chance to meet those whose life and work made them immortal! Bring your imagination

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Jefferson County Historical Society (JCHS) is a non-profit organization founded in 1967 by a group of local founders throughout the county and chartered in 1971.
